Operations.Name: GetAdditionalPart
Operations.Description: Gets additional parts for a video.

Options.Name: userId
Options.Description: Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.

Options.Name: container
Options.Description: The video container. Possible values are: ts, webm, asf, wmv, ogv, mp4, m4v, mkv, mpeg, mpg, avi, 3gp, wmv, wtv, m2ts, mov, iso, flv.

Options.Name: static
Options.Description: Optional. If true, the original file will be streamed statically without any encoding. Use either no url extension or the original file extension. true/false.

Options.Name: params
Options.Description: The streaming parameters.

Options.Name: tag
Options.Description: The tag.

Options.Name: deviceProfileId
Options.Description: Optional. The dlna device profile id to utilize.

Options.Name: playSessionId
Options.Description: The play session id.

Options.Name: segmentContainer
Options.Description: The segment container.

Options.Name: segmentLength
Options.Description: The segment length.

Options.Name: minSegments
Options.Description: The minimum number of segments.

Options.Name: mediaSourceId
Options.Description: The media version id, if playing an alternate version.

Options.Name: deviceId
Options.Description: The device id of the client requesting. Used to stop encoding processes when needed.

Options.Name: audioCodec
Options.Description: Optional. Specify an audio codec to encode to, e.g. mp3. If omitted the server will auto-select using the url's extension.

Options.Name: enableAutoStreamCopy
Options.Description: Whether or not to allow automatic stream copy if requested values match the original source. Defaults to true.

Options.Name: allowVideoStreamCopy
Options.Description: Whether or not to allow copying of the video stream url.

Options.Name: allowAudioStreamCopy
Options.Description: Whether or not to allow copying of the audio stream url.

Options.Name: audioSampleRate
Options.Description: Optional. Specify a specific audio sample rate, e.g. 44100.

Options.Name: maxAudioBitDepth
Options.Description: Optional. The maximum audio bit depth.

Options.Name: audioBitRate
Options.Description: Optional. Specify an audio bitrate to encode to, e.g. 128000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.

Options.Name: audioChannels
Options.Description: Optional. Specify a specific number of audio channels to encode to, e.g. 2.

Options.Name: maxAudioChannels
Options.Description: Optional. Specify a maximum number of audio channels to encode to, e.g. 2.

Options.Name: profile
Options.Description: Optional. Specify a specific an encoder profile (varies by encoder), e.g. main, baseline, high.

Options.Name: level
Options.Description: Optional. Specify a level for the encoder profile (varies by encoder), e.g. 3, 3.1.

Options.Name: framerate
Options.Description: Optional. A specific video framerate to encode to, e.g. 23.976. Generally this should be omitted unless the device has specific requirements.

Options.Name: maxFramerate
Options.Description: Optional. A specific maximum video framerate to encode to, e.g. 23.976. Generally this should be omitted unless the device has specific requirements.

Options.Name: copyTimestamps
Options.Description: Whether or not to copy timestamps when transcoding with an offset. Defaults to false.

Options.Name: startTimeTicks
Options.Description: Optional. Specify a starting offset, in ticks. 1 tick = 10000 ms.

Options.Name: width
Options.Description: Optional. The fixed horizontal resolution of the encoded video.

Options.Name: height
Options.Description: Optional. The fixed vertical resolution of the encoded video.

Options.Name: maxWidth
Options.Description: Optional. The maximum horizontal resolution of the encoded video.

Options.Name: maxHeight
Options.Description: Optional. The maximum vertical resolution of the encoded video.

Options.Name: videoBitRate
Options.Description: Optional. Specify a video bitrate to encode to, e.g. 500000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.

Options.Name: subtitleStreamIndex
Options.Description: Optional. The index of the subtitle stream to use. If omitted no subtitles will be used.

Options.Name: subtitleMethod
Options.Description: Optional. Specify the subtitle delivery method.

Options.Name: maxRefFrames
Options.Description: Optional.

Options.Name: maxVideoBitDepth
Options.Description: Optional. The maximum video bit depth.

Options.Name: requireAvc
Options.Description: Optional. Whether to require avc.

Options.Name: deInterlace
Options.Description: Optional. Whether to deinterlace the video.

Options.Name: requireNonAnamorphic
Options.Description: Optional. Whether to require a non anamorphic stream.

Options.Name: transcodingMaxAudioChannels
Options.Description: Optional. The maximum number of audio channels to transcode.

Options.Name: cpuCoreLimit
Options.Description: Optional. The limit of how many cpu cores to use.

Options.Name: liveStreamId
Options.Description: The live stream id.

Options.Name: enableMpegtsM2TsMode
Options.Description: Optional. Whether to enable the MpegtsM2Ts mode.

Options.Name: videoCodec
Options.Description: Optional. Specify a video codec to encode to, e.g. h264. If omitted the server will auto-select using the url's extension.

Options.Name: subtitleCodec

Options.Name: transcodeReasons

Options.Name: audioStreamIndex
Options.Description: Optional. The index of the audio stream to use. If omitted the first audio stream will be used.

Options.Name: videoStreamIndex
Options.Description: Optional. The index of the video stream to use. If omitted the first video stream will be used.

Options.Name: context
Options.Description: Optional. The MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.EncodingContext.
